svg.title: The harbour boardwalk nearest the viewer: weathered grey deck boards in courses that widen toward the bottom of the screen, with staggered butt joints and a few newer tan replacement boards, and on the deck a mooring cleat, a coil of rope, a slatted wooden lobster trap with a red-and-white buoy and an iron mooring ring. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no named place, no lettering, no figures.
